description: Start a debug session for an iOS app. Provide either bundle_id (launches and attaches) or pid (attaches to a running process). Optional breakpoints[] are armed before the target resumes. Read mobai://reference/debugging first.

breakpoints.description: Initial breakpoint specs. "File.swift:42" (preferred), "Module.Type.method" (no parameter signature), "-[Class method:]", or runtime symbol.

bundle_id.description: App bundle ID to launch and attach. Either this or pid is required.

pid.description: Attach to an already-running PID. Either this or bundle_id is required.

stop_on_entry.description: Simulator only — pause at first instruction.

name: debug_attach
